summary: The WorksheetAssignStudents module manages student assignment to worksheets and PR placements including group and individual workflows, multiple assignment actions, requirement confirmations, unassignments, automated matches, and reporting. It controls user interactions, action dropdowns, data binding, session variables, paging, and assignment workflows with detailed error and warning messaging for business rules and workflow exceptions.
purpose: To facilitate the assignment, confirmation, unassignment, and reporting of students to PR placements and worksheet groups, including handling prerequisites, automated matching, preference reporting, and special admin operations, while validating actions and supporting end-user workflow for placement coordinators and administrators.

workflows.name: Assign Students
steps: Select students via UI controls.
Choose assignment destination from dropdown.
Assign selected students (group or individual) to PR placements.
Handle multiple assignments if group flag is set.
Update assignment state in backend via WorksheetAssignedStudents methods.
Show warnings/errors for duplicate, over-allocated, not accepted, or already assigned students.

workflows.name: Confirm Assignments
steps: Placement coordinator confirms student assignments.
System validates assignment states.
Displays warnings/errors for sibling not confirmed, already allocated, over-allocated, multiple preceptors unbalanced, size mismatch, or not accepted.
Creates history log for confirmed assignments.

workflows.name: Unassign Students
steps: Select students to unassign.
Unassign selected students from worksheet or PR via backend call.
Show warnings/errors for accepted or confirmed after assigned or already allocated.

workflows.name: Requirement Met Status Update
steps: Edit requirement met status for students individually or in batch.
Validate effective date and input.
Error feedback for invalid date or missing effective date.

workflows.name: Automated Matching
steps: Select matching option via dropdown (ASM).
Perform automated matching based on selected criteria (city/date/region, random, combine/mix sections, request code, etc.).
Show statistics and update assignment states.

workflows.name: Undo Worksheet Copy
steps: Sysadmin/local admin removes students from worksheet copy.
Handle exceptions: not on worksheet, assigned, last student.
Show warnings/errors per outcome.

workflows.name: Reporting
steps: Generate PR selection report.
Show summary including program, cohort, term, course, section, campus, date, and author.
Output as HTML or CSV.

business_rules: Only PlacementCoordinator can confirm assignments or update requirements met.
At least one student preference required for preference report.
Assignment must not result in over-allocation or duplicate assignment.
Effective date must be provided and valid when marking requirements met.
Unassignment must not leave students who are assigned or confirmed.
Automated matching options depend on program setup.
validations: Effective date format and presence for requirements met.
Assignment status (accepted, confirmed, duplicate, over-allocated) checked before action.
Student consent expired disables some UI actions.
Form controls must be properly databound.
calculations: Counts of confirmed, duplicate, over-allocated, already assigned, size mismatch, not accepted, multiple preceptors unbalanced, removed, assigned, already assigned, others assigned, pr confirmed.
Page and row counts for UI paging.
conditions: GroupFlag determines group vs individual worksheet logic.
Program configuration and SearchCriteria alters available ASM options.
Student requirements met affects UI visibility and actions.
system_behavior: Session variables tracked for user, section, display options, and paging.
UI actions trigger backend updates and status messaging.
JavaScript injected for dynamic UI behaviors.
Automated match triggers navigation and report updates.
Error and warning messages shown based on outcome.
dependencies: SearchCriteria for filtering and business rule selection.
UI controls (dropdowns, panels, repeaters, formviews) for visibility and state.
exceptions: Assignment or unassignment fails due to over-allocation, not-accepted, already assigned, confirmed, last student, or not on worksheet.
Requirement met fails due to invalid or missing date.
Automated match fails due to ASM setup limitation.
Reporting blocked if no students or preferences.
content_gaps: Underlying database schema for WorksheetAssignedStudent and Enrollments not provided.
Business logic details for WorksheetAssignedStudents backend methods not explicit.
Resource string values (warnings, errors, captions) not present.
UI layout and user interface markup not included; only code-behind and controller logic.
No explicit list of all possible assignment options or destination types.
